title: Sales One Pager
one_line: Write the one page document a prospect forwards internally to the person who has to approve.
description: Write the one page document a prospect forwards internally to the person who has to approve. Use when a deal needs an internal champion, when someone asks for a leave behind, or when a prospect says they need to check with someone.
paragraph: A leave behind is not read by the person you met. It is forwarded to somebody who was not in the meeting, has no context, and is deciding whether to spend money. This skill writes for that second reader, which changes what goes on the page: the problem in their language, the cost of not acting, and the shape of the commitment.
keywords: they need to check with someone
our champion needs something to forward
requirements_summary: Needs no account, key or paid service: it works from the files, exports and answers you give it.
